data.summary: The review data for Stillwaters Pool Company is highly suspicious. A 23-year-old pool company in a major Texas market shows ZERO authentic customer reviews on Google Maps, despite having a business listing. The Google reviews that do appear are clearly misattributed (referring to other companies like Sky Blue Pools). BBB shows an A+ rating but provides no customer reviews or complaint details. Yelp search results show the business but no actual reviews. This pattern suggests either: 1) The business has virtually no online customer feedback despite decades of operation, 2) Reviews have been removed/suppressed, or 3) The business operates primarily through non-digital channels. The complete absence of authentic customer narratives across all platforms is a major red flag.
